text_block_list.name: Acute & Falco
text_block_list.text: You are an eyewitness—♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone!! I'll run and sing with all my 
might next time too, so pleeease be sure 
to come! Falco will be waiting☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(My, how incredible... I wonder... what 
makes her so different from me...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With dorm curfew fast approaching, I 
noticed the dance studio lights were still 
on and decided to take a look inside—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, four♪ Two, two, three, 
four♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer? Fufu, thank you for the 
compliment.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was something bothering her? Wonder Acute 
hesitated, so I asked her what was wrong.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Actually, you see, I shared the stage with 
Falco-san at a fan meetup "live 
concert"...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Even though we're supposed to be dancing 
the same way, Falco-san just shines so 
brightly."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I thought I'd practiced a whole lot too, 
but I still have a long way to go..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Since I have fans cheering me on, I need 
to dedicate myself even more!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Wonder Acute's dancing seems 
utterly flawless to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, if you still feel a gap between 
yourself and Smart Falcon, could it be 
that—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's true. I'm slow at memorizing, but 
I'm good at moving my body, so I'm having 
fun~
choice_data_list: Maybe it'd be good to convey that more.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Conveying... that I'm having fun?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It certainly seems like Falco-san enjoys 
her "pa-formance" more than anyone else 
does, doesn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Right... That's why she looked so 
dazzling...
choice_data_list: Let's show everyone your sparkle too!

Let's make sure everyone sees your 
sparkle, too!
I want to see you having even more fun.
I want to see you having even more fun.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Right... That's why she looked so 
dazzling...
choice_data_list: Let's show everyone your sparkle too!

Let's make sure everyone sees your 
sparkle, too!
I want to see you having even more fun.
I want to see you having even more fun.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. Hearing you put it like that makes 
me feel a little bashful.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Still... you know, it's so much fun 
standing in front of everyone...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I have to make sure I tell them that I'm 
only having fun because they are."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute seemed to have grasped 
something. From that day forward, her 
performance grew even more polished.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well then, Trainer. Would you mind 
lending me a hand?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking how lonely it'd be to 
dance all by myself.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I know I can dance even more joyfully if 
I'm dancing with you, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Wonder Acute's invitation, I practiced 
the dance steps with her, having fun 
despite being unaccustomed to it.
